cosmology.worldEpithet: The Thin Place Between Heaven and Dust
cosmology.summary: The mortal cultivation world sits on a frayed seam of the Great Cycle. Qi rises from dragon veins and settles in marrow; the heavens answer ambition with tribulation lightning, not mercy.
cosmology.upperRealmsNote: Sages say the Upper Realm is not a place but a verdict.

daoConcepts.gloss: Root-nature: the spiritual color you were born with.
Every shortcut leaves a thread; pull enough and heaven tugs back.

cultivationRealms.name: Foundation Establishment
cultivationRealms.blurb: The body becomes a vessel that remembers.

cultivationRealms.blurb: Condense a sun inside the dantian.

cultivationRealms.name: Nascent Soul

cultivationRealms.name: Void Refining
cultivationRealms.blurb: The flesh learns to carry intent like scripture.

cultivationRealms.name: Dao Integration
cultivationRealms.blurb: You stop imitating techniques and start resembling truth.

taboos: Speaking a Nascent Soul's true name within a binding array.
Refining pills during your own tribulation—unless you enjoy lightning-flavored failure.
oaths: May my core shatter if I betray this sect's granary seal.
I borrow heaven's qi; I repay with tribulation—when due.
